newsitem.title: USA: Telular Q1 boosted by Motorola.
newsitem.headline: Telular Q1 boosted by Motorola.

text.p: Telular Corp said shipments to Motorola Inc increased considerably over the prior quarter, helping Telular post a profit of $0.02 a share for the December 31 first quarter compared with a year-ago loss of $0.22.

Telular is shipping product for Motorola's wireless local loop program in Hungary. In addition, Telular said shipments improved to the European, Middle Eastern, African and Asian regions compared with the prior year.
Operating expenses decreased by more than 27 percent from the comparable quarter a year ago, the company said.

Telular has developed telecommunications interface technology that switches a standard phone system fax, computer modem or monitored alarm system to available wireless service for either primary or backup communications.
